HomeIframe.title: Fill The Battery
HomeIframe.description: Fill the battery is a free Puzzle game that needs to get connected. Your goal is to connect energy sources with the batteries to recharge them. Use the reflectors and let the power reach the batteries.

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Fill The Battery is a captivating puzzle game where you connect energy sources to batteries using reflectors, navigating obstacles to achieve a full charge.

HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Use reflectors to guide the energy beam.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Overcome obstacles and fully charge the battery.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Solve intricate puzzles that challenge your spatial reasoning.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Plan your moves carefully to efficiently recharge batteries.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Navigate through various obstacles that block the energy flow.
